# Fixture provenance

Synthetic fixtures generated by prepare_testdata.py; no patient data. Licensed Apache-2.0 with this repository.

- `input.hea` / `cvp.dat`: CVP alternating 6 and 10 mmHg, 1000 samples at 124.945 Hz, one sample per frame (the published family-sample layout).
- `input-frames.hea` / `frames.dat`: PAP alternating 10 and 30 mmHg stored two samples per 62.4725 Hz frame beside an ECG lead II (the raw MIMIC bedside-segment layout); frames must expand to 1000 samples at 124.945 Hz and lead II must be ignored.
- `input-artifact.hea` / `artifact.dat`: CVP held at 397.5 to 398.5 mmHg, the unzeroed-transducer pattern seen in real family samples; healthy, flagged by `cvp_implausible_fraction` = 1 and a note.
- `input-empty.hea`: empty header; degrades.

Real HF family samples are tested from their pinned manifest outside Git; see VALIDATION.md.
